text.name: Pokhran and Chagai
text.rules: Record "two new nuclear states". LIO spends 1 point. SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: India conducted nuclear tests at Pokhran on 11 and 13 May 1998; Pakistan answered with tests at Chagai on 28 and 30 May 1998, and the UN Security Council condemned both in Resolution 1172.
